track: onset-learned (stage-1 track; stage 2 fixed to D's downstream)
deviations: Deviations log for build_onset-learned.py (written 2026-10-06, BEFORE any onset-learned result was computed or seen).
Protocol: experiments/xjtu/v2/PROTOCOL.frozen.md rev 2 (PROTOCOL.md itself is NOT edited: it is the frozen shared copy and
other tracks run in parallel; deviations for this track are logged here and in results/onset-learned.json).
DV1 (task vs protocol; scope). The task asks for "supervised/learned onset detector families in the protocol candidate space".
The frozen candidate space (section 5 item 1) contains NO supervised/learned onset family: ET-onset was removed (A.8,
"No exploratory version is pre-registered here"), and 1.4.3 forbids training anything on the onset GT. Because the task
also says "search ONLY the protocol's candidate space", no supervised onset classifier is trained. The only
label-driven stage-1 learning the protocol allows is the nested inner selection of the 24 rule configs (ratio/dual-gate
x self/fallback) by inner C1, which is computed against the offline onset GT of the 14 training bearings (4.3 step 1).
That is what "onset-learned" (N1) implements. Reported as a scope finding, not hidden.
DV2 (stage 2 fixed, task-directed). Section 4.3 step 2 selects the downstream (672 combos) by nested LOBO. Per the task,
the downstream is fixed to the protocol's simplest reference = D's downstream {hard latch, TSO, global conformal,
model_crit q50<=30, S1 2.0, S2 off} so that the stage-1 effect is isolated. Consequently N1 is NOT the protocol's N;
decision rule 4.4.1 ("N ships") cannot be invoked for N1. All G/P gates are still computed for N1 and are labelled
EXPLORATORY (stage-1-only track). D and D' are computed exactly as pre-registered (D first, before any candidate).
DV3 (ambiguity resolution, recorded before results). pre_onset semantics (harness2 caveat 2): primary = 'provisional'
(2.2 concurrent counters; stage-2 conditions evaluated at a provisional onset = current row, published q50 null while
O=0). Sensitivity 'none' is reported for N1, D, D'. With TSO, provisional q50 = L at tso=0, so this only matters
if a fold's L <= 60.
DV4 (ambiguity resolution). Warm-up: the pipeline replay (causal.replay) never leaves healthy before row 20, so new
pipelines satisfy 2.1/3.1. R0/R1 keep the frozen ungated causal.states_r mapping (as in 4.5); harness2 already reports
the gated sensitivity.
DV5 (ambiguity resolution). TSO L and conformal: L = median over training bearings (bearing-equal) of RUL at the chosen
stage-1's causal FPT; training bearings with no causal onset are excluded from L and from calibration. Inner OOF for
the conformal residuals: L_{-i} from the other 13 training bearings. Probability while O=1 = prob_within(120) from
levels (0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.95) using alpha 0.1 and 0.05 conformal bounds; while O=0, p0 = bearing-equal fleet rate
P(RUL<=120 | O=0, row>=20) on the 14 training bearings under the chosen stage 1.
DV6 (selection metric for stage 1, as pre-registered): stage-1 states for inner C1 are the hard-latch stage-1 replay; under
the fixed hard-latch downstream the non-healthy set equals the O=1 set, so C1 of the stage-1 replay equals C1 of the
full pipeline (checked at run time).
candidate_space: 24 stage-1 rule configs (ratio/dual-gate x self/fallback); no supervised onset family exists in the frozen space (A.8)
selection: nested LOBO: inner C1 on 14 training bearings, E2 stage-1 form, paired 1-SE on C1 with complexity tie-break, fallback D stage 1; stage 2 = TSO + global conformal fixed
